settings.headline: Numbing cream delivery, in plain terms.
settings.subhead: Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Free next-day delivery on orders over £80. Order before 3:30pm on a working day and your parcel is dispatched the same day. Everything ships from the United Kingdom via Royal Mail, in plain, unbranded packaging.
settings.image_alt: Senseless parcel packed for UK delivery

settings.headline: Yes, next-day delivery is available.
settings.body:
There are three delivery options at checkout — standard, express and next working day. Next working day is £8.99, and it is free on orders of £80 or more. Standard is £1.99, and free from £40. Express sits between them at £3.99.

The cut-off is the part that decides whether your order moves today. Order before 3:30pm on a working day and it is dispatched the same day. Order after 3:30pm, or at a weekend or on a bank holiday, and it is dispatched the next working day. Delivery estimates begin from dispatch, not from when you place the order.

settings.headline: Standard, express or next working day.
settings.caption: UK delivery options, prices, free-delivery thresholds and estimates
settings.note:
Order £80 or more and next working day is the option you get, at no charge. Between £40 and £79.99 standard is free, with express and next working day available at the prices above. Below £40 all three are chargeable.

Orders placed after 3:30pm, at a weekend or on a bank holiday are dispatched the next working day. Delivery estimates begin from dispatch, not from when you order. We ship to the UK only at present.

settings.heading: Leave yourself a working day in hand.
settings.body: The two things that decide when a parcel arrives are the 3:30pm cut-off and the working-day calendar, and a bank holiday moves both. If your appointment is close, next-day delivery ordered before 3:30pm on a working day is the quickest route we offer — and if it is not close, standard delivery over £40 costs nothing and gives you room if a parcel is delayed.

settings.question: Do you offer next-day delivery on numbing cream?
settings.answer: Yes. Next working day delivery is available at checkout on every product in the range. It is £8.99, and free on UK orders of £80 or more. Order before 3:30pm on a working day and your parcel is dispatched the same day.

settings.question: How much does delivery cost?
settings.answer: Three options: standard £1.99, express £3.99, next working day £8.99. Standard is free from £40, and next working day is free from £80. Every price is shown at checkout before you pay.

settings.question: What is the cut-off for same-day dispatch?
settings.answer: 3:30pm on a working day. Orders placed after 3:30pm, at a weekend, or on a bank holiday are dispatched the next working day. Delivery estimates begin from dispatch.

settings.question: Will it arrive before my appointment?
settings.answer: That depends on when you order rather than on anything about the product. Next working day, placed before 3:30pm on a working day, is the quickest route available; a weekend or a bank holiday pushes dispatch to the next working day. Standard is estimated at 4–6 working days and express at 2–3, both from dispatch — so if the appointment is close, order early in the day and choose next working day.

settings.question: Is the packaging discreet?
settings.answer: Yes. Every order is dispatched in plain, unbranded packaging, and parcels are designed to fit through a standard letterbox wherever possible.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: A confirmation email with a Royal Mail tracking link is sent as soon as your order is dispatched. You can also track directly at royalmail.com/track-your-item. If nothing arrives within 24 hours, check your spam folder, then email cs@senseless.uk.

settings.question: Do you deliver outside the UK?
settings.answer: Not at present. We ship to the United Kingdom only.

settings.question: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
settings.answer: If the order has not been dispatched yet, email cs@senseless.uk and we will change it. Once it has been dispatched the address cannot be changed.

settings.question: My order hasn't arrived. What now?
settings.answer: Check the tracking link first — it is the fastest answer. If the expected window has passed with no update, email cs@senseless.uk with your order number. Please report delivery problems within 14 days of the expected delivery date.
